source_grounding.call_chain_traced: REST PUT /collections/{name} body wal_config (WalConfigDiff: Option<usize>, no range attr on wal_retain_closed, so documented-legal 0 passes the validator — only wal_capacity_mb carries range(min=1), which matches the observed 422 face) -> lib/storage/src/content_manager/toc/create_collection.rs:148 storage_config.wal.update_opt(diff) -> WalConfig::update (config_diff.rs:292) resolves wal_retain_closed=Some(0), overriding default 1, with no validation of the merged config (the range(min=1) attribute on WalConfig is never invoked on this path) -> CollectionConfigInternal -> Collection::new -> LocalShard::build_shard (local_shard/mod.rs:372) SerdeWal::new(.., (&wal_config).into()) -> From<&WalConfig> for WalOptions (config.rs:62) NonZeroUsize::new(0).unwrap() panics inside the shard-creation tokio task -> JoinError -> StorageError::service_error('Tokio task join error: task N panicked ...') (errors.rs:334) -> HTTP 500 with /healthz alive. The panic message, the ~1.2s latency (storage created before the panic), and the error body all match the observed logs.
source_grounding.outcome_note: validation_absent at the enforcement point: the input face performs NO minimum validation on wal_retain_closed (no validator attribute in WalConfigDiff) and the create-merge path performs NO re-validation of the merged WalConfig even though the internal struct itself declares range(min=1); the internal min-1 domain is instead 'enforced' by NonZeroUsize::new(..).unwrap() panicking on a documented-legal 0. by_design_in_source is NOT supportable: there is no intent marker (comment/docstring/maintainer citation) near the unwrap, and the presence of the range(min=1) attribute on the internal struct indicates the intended mechanism was input validation, not a panic; the diff face (min 0) and resolved face (min 1) are mutually inconsistent.
